annotations.title: Read the leads from an X lead form

description: Read the leads submitted to an X lead form over a window (default the last 30 days) — each lead's answers keyed by field (EMAIL, FULL_NAME…). X builds the export as a job; this waits up to ~45s and, if X is still working, returns an exportId to collect later with no new job. X lets only an ACCOUNT ADMIN export leads, and refuses an ARCHIVED form, so export before archiving. format csv/xlsx returns a download link instead. The result is personal information. Free.

adAccountId.description: X ad account id (list_x_ads_accounts); omit if only one is shared

days.description: window length when startTime is omitted; default 30

exportId.description: collect an export that was still running

format.description: json (default, returns leads inline) | csv | xlsx (returns a download link)

leadFormId.description: X lead form id from list_x_ads_lead_forms; required unless exportId is given

name: get_x_ads_leads
title: Read the leads from an X lead form
